novel_features.name: Migration blockers
novel_features.description: One verdict per VM (blocked, review, ready, or unknown when a check could not run) with reason codes: snapshots, vCenter's consolidation-needed flag, delta chains without snapshots, attached ISOs, VMware Tools missing or stopped, PVSCSI controllers, NVMe disks, EFI firmware and VMXNET NICs.

novel_features.name: Snapshots audit
novel_features.description: Every snapshot in the vCenter as a row with age, tree depth and quiesced flag, plus per-VM delta-disk and snapshot-file totals and the VMs vCenter says need consolidation.

novel_features.name: Licence exposure
novel_features.description: Licensable cores per host, cluster and vCenter under Broadcom's 16-cores-per-CPU minimum, next to current licence editions and usage with keys masked.

novel_features.name: Migration capacity
novel_features.description: Per-cluster sizing totals: VMs, vCPU, vRAM, physical cores and RAM with overcommit ratios, and provisioned versus committed versus guest-used storage, each with the count of items it covers.

novel_features.name: Proxmox map
novel_features.description: Each VM's sizing, firmware, disks, NICs and guest OS beside the Proxmox VE qm settings they map to (bios, efidisk0, ostype, sockets, cores, memory, scsihw, netN with model and MAC, disk slots, boot order, smbios1), following Proxmox's own VMware importer.

novel_features.name: RVTools CSV export
novel_features.description: Writes the RVTools CSV tabs that AWS Transform and other assessment tools read (vInfo, vCPU, vMemory, vDisk, vPartition, vNetwork, vTools, vHost, vSource, plus vSnapshot) from macOS or Linux; without --out it prints them as JSON.
